bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM FRIDAY AFTERNOON THROUGH FRIDAY EVENING... Combined seas 6 to 8 ft rising to around 9 to 11 ft tomorrow afternoon. Bar conditions moderate becoming rough tomorrow afternoon. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 345 PM Thursday, 400 AM Friday, and 430 PM Friday. The ebb on Friday afternoon will be strong.
